subject: Problems with non-wear time and window length

messages.author: 57fc84dc76e4176a
messages.subject: Problems with non-wear time and window length
parts:
Hi Vincent and all,

 

I’m currently using GGIR to process 7-day Actigraph data. As the measurement unfortunately didn’t start at midnight, but rather during the day, the assessment period includes in fact 8 days (with half a day at the beginning and at the end of the measurement period). As we are only interested in the 6 full days in the middle, I set “timewindow” to “MM” in order to ignore the half days.

 

For part 2 (day summary) everything seems correct (day 1 and 8 are ignored), except for the 7th day. For each participant (n=56) I have 23.751 “N valid hours” for the 7th day.

For part 5 (day summary) a similar problem occurs. Here the second day has always a non-wear time of 0.9986 h for each participant. Additionally, for some participants the days are shifted, so that the output starts with the second day and ends with the 7th day. The window length has then also a value higher than 24 hours (e.g. 28.75 hours) for the first day.

 

Is there maybe a way to correct this or does somebody know why this happens? Setting ”excludefirstlast.part5” to TRUE didn’t change the problem with the non-wear time and also changing the “maxdur“-value didn’t solve the problem.

 

Please find the used shell script below.

 

Thanks in advance!

Anne Backes

 

 

 

library(GGIR)

g.shell.GGIR(#=======================================

             # INPUT NEEDED:

             mode=c(1,2,3,4,5),         

             datadir="//myinputdir/",

             outputdir="//myoutputdir/",

             f0=1, f1=56,                

            

             #-------------------------------

             # Part 1

             #-------------------------------

             windowsizes = c(5,900,3600),           

             do.cal = TRUE,

             do.enmo = TRUE,            

             do.anglex=TRUE,             

             do.angley=TRUE,            

             do.anglez=TRUE,            

             chunksize=1,

             printsummary=TRUE,

             idloc = 2,                 

             desiredtz = "Europe/Brussels",

            

             #-------------------------------

             # Part 2

             #-------------------------------

             strategy = 2,

             maxdur = 8,                

             includedaycrit = 10,       

             dayborder = 0,             

             winhr = 5,                 

             qlevels = c(0.25,0.5,0.75),  

             qwindow=c(0,24),           

             ilevels = c(seq(0,400,by=50),8000),      

             iglevels = c(seq(0,4000,by=25),8000),     

             mvpathreshold =c(100.6), 

             boutduration = 120,        

             boutcriter = 0.8,          

             bout.metric = 4,           

             closedbout=FALSE,          

            

             #-------------------------------

             # Part 3

             #-------------------------------

             timethreshold = 5,         

             acc.metric = "ENMO",       

             anglethreshold = 5,        

             ignorenonwear = TRUE,      

             do.part3.pdf = FALSE,       

            

             #-------------------------------

             # Part 4

             #-------------------------------

             excludefirstlast = FALSE,  

             includenightcrit = 10,     

             def.noc.sleep = 1,         

             do.visual = TRUE,          

             outliers.only = FALSE,     

             criterror = 4,             

             loglocation= c(),          

             relyonsleeplog = FALSE,    

            

             #-------------------------------

             # Part 5

             #-------------------------------

             threshold.lig = c(44.8),    

             threshold.mod = c(100.6),   

             threshold.vig = c(428.8),   

             boutcriter.in = 0.9,      

             boutcriter.lig = 0.8,                   

             boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8,    

             boutdur.in = c(10,20,30), 

             boutdur.lig = c(1,5,10),  

             boutdur.mvpa = c(1,5,10), 

             save_ms5rawlevels = TRUE, 

            

             #-----------------------------------

             # Visual report generation

             #-------------------------------

             do.report = c(2,3,4,5),

             timewindow = c("MM"),    

             visualreport = TRUE,     

             dofirstpage = TRUE,       

             viewingwindow = 1)

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Problems with non-wear time and window length
parts:
Hi Anne,

I think the problem is that using strategy = 2 is the problem, because I originally designed that for studies who have sleeplogs and want to ignore the first and last night.
The issue you report for part 2 seems to indicate a minor bug specific the strategy=2 setting, I will add it to the Github issue tracker.

If you make the following changes to your script the output should look a lot better.
strategy = 1,
includenightcrit = 16
includedaycrit = 16,
excludefirstlast = FALSE,   #< affects part 4
excludefirstlast.part5 =TRUE, # affects part 5

When I try this the output has:
- 6 or 7 days in the part 2 output (7 days if either the first or last day has 16 hours of wear time data).
- 7 nights in the part 4 output
- 6 full days in the part 5 MM output

Best, Vincent

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Problems with non-wear time and window length
parts:
Hi Anne,

The data you provide include a daylight saving time day, that's why you get 23 or 25 hours in this specific day.

Best,
Jairo
